overall: The AG found no violation. The meeting was held in person at an open, accessible location and the notice listed only that location, so no remote access was required. The AG also reminded the Board that any person may record or transmit an open session, which the Board may not discourage or prohibit.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board cut off local-access TV filming before the final agenda item at its Dec. 20, 2021 meeting, denying public access.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board held its December 20, 2021, meeting in-person at a location that was physically open and accessible to the public, and the notice only specified the in-person location for the meeting, the Board was not required to provide a method of alternative remote access to the meeting.
